verdict.rationale: Jan is a desktop AI app with a local OpenAI-compatible API server, so webhook event subscriptions are a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The API reference covers only request/response endpoints (models, chat completions, messages). Agent actions via WhatsApp, Discord or Slack are chat-app integrations and do not qualify as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
